name: Sakura Taisen Monogatari ~Mysterious Paris~
original_name: サクラ大戦物語 〜ミステリアス巴里〜
source: A visual novel set a year after Sakura Taisen 3. A dancer has disappeared at Chatnoir Theatre, and the Japanese detective Akechi Kojirou is tasked with the case. He will be supported by the Hanagumi and his younger sister, Miki.
